Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing for Nimbus Health — follow-up & next steps

Hi Julia —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we land on the right agenda for the sizing session:

- Primary workload: clinical chart summarization + conversational triage (API integration).
- Expected steady-state qps: ~10–12 req/s (600–720 req/min).
- Average prompt + response tokens: ~120 tokens (response-heavy).
- P95 latency target: <= 300ms per request for the user-facing path; background batch jobs can be higher.
- Data residency: US-only, HIPAA-related controls required.

Next step: schedule a 60–75 minute dedicated-capacity sizing call with our solution engineering team to:
1) walk throughput/latency targets against model/profile tradeoffs,
2) review autoscaling/burst patterns and warm-up strategies, and
3) confirm recommended GPU pool sizing + cache/batching knobs.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Thu Mar 12, 10:00–11:15
- Thu Mar 12, 14:00–15:15
- Fri Mar 13, 09:00–10:15

I've attached a short workbook (nimbus-throughput-workbook.xlsx) and our concise sizing guide (redwood-dedicated-sizing-guidance.pdf). If you can fill the workbook before the call it will speed things up — key rows are traffic shape, concurrency, token distribution, and any existing perf traces.

Please let me know which slot works and who from your infra/ML infra teams will join (we recommend your infra lead + SRE). We'll bring Rishi (solutions lead) and Aditya (sales engineer) on our side.

Thanks,
Aisha
